consequence.statement: The option was unused, so removing it has no operational effect; any value set for it is no longer a recognised option.

original.statement: The unused Helm value proxy.sidecarImageRegex has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0.

decision.reason: [ev-3fb29eea728d] calls `proxy.sidecarImageRegex` an "unused" Helm option. That means a value set for it had no effect before 1.16.0 either, so removing it does not stop anything from being honoured. Nothing in the evidence says that anything fails, is rejected or behaves differently. Classing this as setting-ignored (P1) would claim mandatory work the evidence doesn't support, so kind none (informational) with low severity is right.
